title: biancaea millettii

It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Biancaea millettii include alkaloids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
